expo.name: MoneyMart

infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: MoneyMart uses your camera to photograph items you are listing and to verify your identity.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: MoneyMart needs access to your photos so you can add item images to a listing.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: MoneyMart uses the microphone when you go live in a stream.

extra.//apiUrl: The gateway a release build talks to. Change it here for a different environment, or at runtime from the Diagnostics panel on the device — a physical phone cannot reach 127.0.0.1, which is why this is not localhost.

expo.description: MoneyMart — Bid. Stream. Win. Live creator auctions, traditional auction house sales and a verified secondary marketplace.
